name: Vilanova de la Barca (Spain)
description: Green field with a white wavy stripe of five crests near the lower edge, charged at the upper hoist with a white sailing boat.
history: The official flag of Vilanova de la Barca is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, green, with a white wavy fess of five crests of thickness 1/16 of the height of the cloth, set at 1/6 from the lower edge.

features.role: wavy fess of five crests set at 1/6 from the lower edge
